title: Use an exact recurrent degree-five network to obstruct direct terminal-rarity extension
statement: For the reversible one-linkage network 0<->B, 0<->A+2B, 0<->2A+3B with all six rates one, the reachable class from zero is N_0^2. Its exact invariant probability pi(a,b)=exp(-2)/(a!b!) satisfies detailed balance on each pair and has finite expected total reaction intensity, proving nonexplosion and positive recurrence. At reachable marked states ((n,0),0) with residual rho_n=(n,0), every complex c and enabled source s at rho_n+c satisfy (rho_n+c)_c>=(rho_n+c)_s. Thus the exact marked-potential mean increment sum_s p(s) log((rho_n+c)_c/(rho_n+c)_s) is nonnegative; designated target-following steps have zero increments, and each fixed-residual episode of this construction has nonnegative expected drift. Stoichiometric rank is two, so no divergent linear conservation law removes these states. This obstructs the direct higher-molecularity terminal-rarity construction; the same network is recurrent and is not a counterexample to the recurrence conjecture.

requires: Finite stochastic mass-action reaction graph with arbitrary finite species count, complexes in N_0^d, every constant rate kappa_r>0 and weak reversibility. Generator Lf(x)=sum_r kappa_r*(x)_(y_r)*(f(x+y'_r-y_r)-f(x)), with falling-factorial propensities and disabled sources. The full target quantifies over every initial population and every nonabsorbing reachable class: nonexplosion, positive recurrence, unique stationary probability and TV convergence. Absorbing singletons carry point mass. The full theorem assumes no complex balance, added outflows, given Lyapunov certificate, bounded class or stationary oracle. Rank-one, mass-degree and cone results retain their extra stated conditions.

assumptions: Closed mutual reachability does not imply finite mean returns or nonexplosion. Rank-one ordering does not control competing directions in rank>=2. The negative mass drift holds only in the specified cone; the restoring source can be disabled at boundary faces. D>=3 gives no global linear Lyapunov upper bound from this calculation. The degree-five example is explicitly positive recurrent and refutes only a direct terminal-rarity/fixed-residual proof extension; accepted binary one-linkage and earlier terminal-gap results remain at their original scopes. Supplied/producer literature descriptions, unresolved chat citation handles and an announced two-species result are not new Capital governing-original reads or an unrestricted theorem import. No held paper/GitHub tree, mirror, original ZIP or extra attachment was recovered. GPT-6 standard/Extra High was selected at dispatch; exact model throughout, helper models and compute remain unconfirmed. This completed Xi return is separate from human-interrupted earlier material and establishes no model-comparison winner.
costs: Analytic generator inequalities, stationary-law/detailed-balance and marked-potential identities; no new Capital stochastic simulation, source scientific script, numerical replay or general mixing/resource-complexity claim. Constants depend on the fixed finite network and positive rates; cone constants also depend on eta. Standard Foster/nonexplosion/irreducible-CTMC consequences are used at their stated hypotheses. Rank-one recurrence is credited to Wiuf-Xu and the lifted reachability proof to Kriebel Lemma2.2, not counted as newly discovered machinery.
contract.units: Falling-factorial propensities, exact stationary probability, marked log-factorial episode drift and molecularity.
obstruction: Prove class-wise nonexplosion and finite expected returns for all weakly reversible networks with arbitrary high-order boundary layers and linkage-class interference, or supply one explicit network/rates/reachable class with proved explosion, null recurrence or transience. Interior radial drift and a recurrent counterexample to one marked proof mechanism do not discharge that endpoint.

review.scope: Actual source analytic recurrent comparator and scoped method counterexample. Earlier binary/terminal-gap results are not invalidated and no new simulation is claimed.
